items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 14 at 4:02AM PST until November 14 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 8
to 14 feet, peaking Saturday. Surf may locally reach 15 feet
near Ventura Harbor, where surf will likely be the largest.
Dangerous rip currents expected. For the Coastal Flood
Advisory, minor to moderate coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches. Surf will we highest for west-
northwest facing beaches.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 3 PM PST Tuesday. For
the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 4 AM to 4 PM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate flooding of sea water is likely over some
vulnerable low-lying coastal areas that are normally dry,
especially around the time of high tide, including over beach
parking lots, bike paths, and harbor walkways. Moderate beach
erosion is likely. Isolated damage is unlikely but possible.
There is an increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip currents
can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large breaking waves
can cause injury, wash people off beaches and rocks, and
capsize small boats near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A series of significant west-
northwesterly swells are expected to produce large surf into
next week with highest surf and greatest impacts likely
peaking Saturday and potentially again Monday. Minor to
moderate coastal flooding impacts are possible, especially
when largest surf overlaps with peak high tides. Some of these
impacts may be moderate to significant beach erosion and
shallow flooding of normally dry beaches and walkways.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 14 at 8:21AM PST until November 15 at 3:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt.
Mugu CA including Santa Cruz Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 13 at 2:53PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
A large west to northwesterly swell is expected to produce
breaking waves at the Morro Bay and Ventura Harbor entrances
on Saturday. These conditions have a history of capsizing vessels
of various sizes resulting in serious injury or death, even to
the most experienced mariners. Mariners are urged to stay clear of
these harbor entrances. For more information, contact the local
harbor patrol or coast guard station...and continue to monitor
NOAA Weather Radio for the latest weather information..
